note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first eight candidates, so the rest were looked up only on pages whose address was already known (school districts' own board pages, the candidates' own sites, the party's own page). Ken Goike's birth year appears on Wikipedia, but no citation for it was checked, so it is left out. A blank here means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
